limitations: Harvey is the pinned public LAB harness, not proprietary hosted Harvey.
Five task pairs are descriptive evidence, not a statistically established general winner.
The initial ten arms ran concurrently; the final Opulent task-03 retry ran with only that unfinished arm active, so its latency has different provider load.
Known native token usage excludes unreturned usage on physical failed/retried provider requests. Native dollar charges and E2B costs are not measured.
Polygres is repository provenance architecture, not a verified live database connection. Hosted MCP, storage and other unavailable integrations were not faked.

RLM state reads and completed child VMs do not imply every completed child report was read in full or critically assessed. Some printed report slices and kernel stdout were truncated; no blanket complete-adoption claim is made.
Supplementary task-04 truth reconciliation supplies full canonical amendment footnotes without crediting those hidden bodies as answerer consultation.
Original Jev pass decisions remain visible where the independent output/source review disagrees; scores from different judges are not averaged.

The fresh child/RLM delivery recheck proves relevant canonical quotations reached the parent but were omitted from its grading packet; the 05-6 absence rationale and semantic aggregate conclusion are not final.
This historical regrade does not measure the separately versioned delivery-v9 runtime or establish screenshot-coordinate actuation.
Strict Boolean failures include explicitly documented presentation and authority-description disputes; they must not be described as ten material legal errors.
The five-pair sample does not establish statistical superiority, general legal competence or lawyer sign-off.
